subject: prd/impl-review
statement: The complete frozen semantic demand and its identity and derivation-policy version, actual band and join policy, selected harness and review role, effective mapping policy, qualifications, and override shall parse as closed versioned data; identical inputs shall produce one identical pass set and exact/promoted/unsupported resolution using zero inference and zero network I/O through the terminal result. Until the coordinated parent append-first policy is effective, the compatibility path shall retain the existing zero-network pre-invocation boundary. Once that parent policy is effective, impl-review shall durably append every pass-routing terminal to the configured canonical git evidence store and exact-read it successfully before the route may authorize a selected review model invocation or contribute to the process result. The append and exact-read are then the only network operations permitted in that admission interval: no policy lookup, qualification lookup, harness probe, model call, or other outbound operation may occur.
fit_criterion: every missing, changed, unknown, native-in-demand, selected-harness-mismatch, and version fixture fails before invocation; reordered candidate inputs resolve identically; dependency inspection proves zero inference/network through resolution and proves the pre-parent compatibility path remains zero-network; after parent activation, every healthy-store route trace contains a successful canonical append and exact-read before invocation or process use and no other network operation; a zero-evidence healthy path fails, while unavailable or unverifiable evidence produces zero review-model invocations, no asserted verified canonical terminal, and a non-accepting persistence failure under UB-10
